*You probably all know this by now......but one of our 3rd Year English teachers, Jinguuji Marimo-sensei......passed away recently.*
*Jinguuji-sensei worked tirelessly for all of us, always bright and kind, though sometimes strict, both as your teacher and as a graduate from this very academy.*
*Regretfully, the man responsible lived very close to all of us.*
